title: AI/ML Engineer Academy
valueStatement: Training applet with five isolated Python labs, pytest in CI, and a local certificate that does not ingest lab output.
architectureHighlight: React/Express classroom plus per-module GitHub Actions; in-browser simulators are teaching toys, not live vLLM.
description: An interactive training platform for production AI/ML: five curriculum modules, architecture simulators, isolated Python labs, and a field atlas that distinguishes CPU-proved work from survey topics. The GitHub repo is public. The in-app certificate is a localStorage keepsake, not a vendor credential.
pitch: Training applet with five isolated Python labs, pytest in CI, and a local certificate that does not ingest lab output.
challenge: Most AI courses skip Docker, evals, promotion gates, and the difference between a local notebook and a served system. The academy had to train that stack without pretending a browser quiz is production competence — or that a canned “Run code” panel is pytest.
development: Built a React 19 + Vite 6 SPA with Express (server.ts) on port 3000. Optional xAI Grok mentor via XAI_API_KEY (default grok-4.6, rate-limited); curriculum fallback if the key is missing. Five labs, each with its own requirements.txt and venv: foundations (FastAPI SSE, TF-IDF, leakage/PII/RAG clinics, Docker), LLM mechanics (NumPy TODOs; QLoRA optional), governed agents (HITL, SQL/MCP, Dual-LLM stub; LangGraph survey-only), secure serving (auth/rate-limit/CPU bench; vLLM optional), production operations (offline eval, canary/rollback; DeepEval/Promptfoo/HF/Render optional). Frontend vitest plus five lab workflows in GitHub Actions.
outcome: Public source at github.com/rubyrayjuntos/AIML-Engineer-Academy. Certificate unlock is localStorage (all modules marked complete, lab checkboxes confirmed, quizzes ≥60%). The UI does not parse pytest XML. This static portfolio cannot host the applet.

gallery.title: Learning control plane
gallery.description: Holographic model, code, retrieval, security, and evals around one engineer — the academy’s metaphor for putting the whole stack in one field of view

journey.title: Train the job, not the buzzword
journey.description: Modules follow the production stack: SWE+ML, LLM internals, governed agents, secure serving, eval/release. If it is not on that matrix, it is not a required lab.

journey.title: Labs that conflict on purpose
journey.description: Each module gets its own venv. CUDA, browser, and eval extras live in separate requirements files so default CI stays CPU and offline.

journey.title: Evidence before the keepsake
journey.description: pytest and evidence JSON run in the lab (and in GitHub Actions). The applet asks you to confirm that you ran them. That confirm is a checkbox, not an ingest of the test report. The PDF in localStorage is a souvenir.

journey.title: Atlas as the honest map
journey.description: A static field atlas separates CPU-proved labs from survey and optional-live topics so the marketing page cannot outrun the work.

journey.title: Simulators are not the serving stack
journey.description: In-browser panels (vLLM, diffusion, ReAct, MCP) are teaching toys. /api/simulate-code returns canned logs. Real serving evidence is the module-4 FastAPI CPU path.

specs.title: Five-module production curriculum
specs.description: 1 Foundations (FastAPI SSE, Docker, TF-IDF, leakage/PII/RAG). 2 LLM mechanics (attention/KV/LoRA/MoE/DPO/diffusion toys). 3 Governed agents (HITL, SQL/MCP, Dual-LLM stub). 4 Secure serving (auth, rate limits, CPU benchmarks). 5 Eval, canary, rollback. LangGraph, PagedAttention, and multi-cloud deploy stay survey or optional.

specs.title: Isolated labs with pytest in CI
specs.description: Each lab has requirements.txt, pytest, and a GitHub Actions workflow. Module 1 also docker-builds. Module 2 CI sets ACADEMY_SOLUTION=1 to grade reference mechanics; learners leave that unset.

specs.title: Mentor in the loop, curriculum without it
specs.description: Optional xAI Grok behind XAI_API_KEY, IP rate limit, prompt truncation. Missing key or upstream failure uses a keyword fallback. The applet still teaches.

specs.title: Field atlas, not a sales page
specs.description: Standalone static atlas at /atlas/: audience, contents, non-goals, filterable CPU-proved vs survey vs optional-live.

specs.title: Certificate is local, not accredited
specs.description: Requires modules marked complete, lab confirms, and module quizzes or the program quiz at ≥60%. Not a vendor credential. Not proof the CI labs ran on the learner’s machine.

specs.title: This site cannot host the applet
specs.description: SPA + Express on port 3000. Portfolio is static HTML. GitHub is the public surface until a separate host exists.
